formal_rule: Anchor every cell strictly to the human practitioner's prerequisite floor (Hours_learn & Capital); forbid conflating L1/L2 consumer usage with the L6 cluster cost that pretrained the model, and forbid downgrading formal L4+ mathematical/system invariants merely because they are typed in English.

invariant_name: The Meta-Bootstrapping Gate ('Why Not Level L-1?')
formal_rule: A workflow belongs at Level L only if an L-1 user fails even when attempting (a) By-Name Delegation ('Use library X') or (b) Research-and-Elicit Socratic Synthesis ('Interview me to build X'), due to context rot, hallucination, unverified state corruption, or security boundary violation.

Enforce strict cognitive progression across rungs: Tier 1 Outcome Intent & Surface Taste (L1, 0h) -> Tier 1-2 Structured Prompting & Workspace Curation (L2, <50h) -> Tier 2 Declarative Pattern, API & Coupled IDE/CLI Literacy (L3, <200h) -> Tier 3 Formal System, Context & Decoupled Oracle Specification (L4, ~600h) -> Tier 4A/4B Distributed Infra, Post-Training & Frontier Theory (L5-L6, ~2,000h-10,000h).

invariant_name: Failure-Boundary Anchor (Coupled Execution vs. Decoupled Oracles)
formal_rule: Coupled happy-path generation + self-authored unit testing belongs at L2/L3 (Vibe Coding / Coupled CLI), whereas designing independent property-based, simulation, or formal verification oracles that prevent Reward Hacking and Code Slop belongs strictly at L4+.

invariant_name: Recursive Cannibalization Rule ('Why Not Level L+1?')
formal_rule: Every rung L_k in Generation G_t recursively consumes automation from G_t-L_{1..k-1} to eliminate boilerplate toil; prove why L_k's own AI delegation makes escalating to L+1 unnecessary capital/hour waste for that scope.

invariant_name: Setup Half-Life & Dual Sinking Check ('From Gen G-1 / To Gen G+1')
formal_rule: Audit both vendor GUI productization (Supply-Side Sinking) and intra-generational conversational bootstrapping (Demand-Side Sinking) explaining why a G-1 higher-rung skill sinks 1-to-3 rungs downward in G_t and G+1.
